Vercel Pro is $20 per month, but the official docs describe it as a platform fee rather than a per-user price. Per Vercel's docs, the Pro platform fee is $20/month, which includes 1 deploying team seat and $20/month in usage credit. Additional deploying seats cost $20 each per month, while Viewer seats are free.

Usage beyond the included allocations is billed separately. Each month, you have 1 TB Fast Data Transfer and 10,000,000 Edge Requests included. Once those are exceeded, Vercel will charge usage against your monthly credit before switching to on-demand billing.

Third-party sources describe the price as "$20 per user per month," which matches the seat cost but leaves out the platform fee structure. Vercel's own docs are the more authoritative source. Pricing may also vary by when a team was created: teams created on or after September 9, 2025, will be on this pricing model automatically, and teams on the legacy Pro plan are still supported, but will be moved to the new pricing model later this year. Check vercel.com/pricing for current figures.

content.text:
Vercel's Pro plan costs **$20 per month**. Vercel's docs describe this as a platform fee, not a flat per-user price.

- **What the $20 includes:** one deploying team seat and $20 per month of usage credit.
- **Extra seats:** each additional deploying seat costs $20 per month. Viewer seats are free.
- **Included usage:** 1 TB of Fast Data Transfer and 10,000,000 Edge Requests per month. Usage past those amounts is charged against your monthly credit first, then billed on demand.
- **Older teams:** teams created on or after September 9, 2025 are on this model automatically. Teams on the legacy Pro plan are still supported but are due to be moved to it.
